scope: Independent read-only native password-bound MFA enrollment and installed framework/process review
observations: Distinct stage and context domains prevent either enrolled login method from finishing setup or setup confirmation from consuming enrolled login
Password recheck, strict unverified single-factor restart and immutable lifecycle/current encrypted-pool binding preserve identity and failure budgets
Unbiased bounded default-code generation and actual installed source raw UTF8 base32/path-form URI profile interoperate
Factor/user enablement precedes canonical trigger revocation; fresh session, replay, burn and audit stay in the same transaction; code/cookie output follows known commit
Actual source decrypts native factor/pool, reads completed session and authenticates native-issued TOTP and backup codes on a separate synthetic copy
WAL/DELETE writer checkpoints, restart/lock boundaries, exact disclosure once, full late SQL rollback and real commit-busy in both phases were independently repeated
review_loop: Design review requested explicit phase isolation, restart budget preservation, trigger rollback order, lost-response behavior and legacy actor-label semantics; contract includes them before implementation
Implementation review found no material defect; focused native URI test passed
Main initial process suite passed168 cases; tightened concurrent begin to deterministic writer checkpoint and added malformed-lock/duplicate-factor restart refusals

Final independent process suite passed170 cases; all native/case-module hashes unchanged; main harness changed only one report scope label from enrolled-only to enrollment plus enrolled login, then main reran170 cases on that exact final script
limits: Internal initial/unverified setup only, no public endpoint or active-session backup viewing/regeneration/reset/management
No actual physical opened-handle/lifetime, live dual writers, historical chronology/normalization, restore lineage or full identity/cutover qualification
Legacy system:better-auth trigger actor remains compatibility label; source enrollment-session and early code disclosure deliberately differ
